results.test: U1 Ultra Chat opens by default and reads only: capability, Workspaces, history and the EVM badge
U2 the read token travels only in its own header to /ultra/chat/* and is stored nowhere
U3 history renders server text as text, labels outcomes and never shows an old failure as an answer
U4 every data state is told apart: workspaces, chats and history
U5 older pages are fetched with the cursor, prepended once, and the button hides at the start
U6 after a server restart the page fetches one new capability and repeats once, then stops honestly
U7 an unavailable capability is explained and the other sections keep working
U8 the composer is visibly read-only and nothing is ever posted
U9 sections switch both ways and \#operator / \#evm open a section directly
U10 a late answer for a Workspace that is no longer selected is ignored
U11 malformed server answers show an error and invent nothing
U12 the EVM model badge tells every saved-choice state
E1 Ultra Chat is the default view; at load the catalog is not asked, only the saved choice for the chat badge
E2 opening EVM renders exactly the server catalog in the API column, other columns empty
E3 choosing a model posts only role + connection_id once and shows the saved choice
E4 a refused choice is reported and the list is reloaded from the server, not changed locally
E5 malformed or failed catalog answers show an error and no invented models
E6 saved-choice states are told honestly
E7 disabled models cannot be chosen and server text is never markup
E8 the way back restores the operator panel; refresh reloads the catalog
E9 the shipped page carries no model list of its own
O1 workspace filter and task selection never mix details
O2 timeline shows persisted DONE separately from VERIFIED
O3 inconsistent read has no progress value or usable copy action
O4 absent current operation stays undetermined
O5 offline retains last snapshot visibly stale and disables copying NEXT
O5 ageing snapshot becomes stale without inventing runtime status
O6 server NEXT copied exactly; no client authority decisions
O7 navigation refresh disclosure emit only GET
O8 restored browser selection still fetches server-owned state
O9 old task response cannot repaint new selected task
O9 loading clears old task details immediately
O9 response identity mismatch is an error, never another workspace data
O9 HTML and script input remains text in rendered nodes
